title: B.P.R.D. Collectible Ring — Hellboy II: The Golden Army
description:
B.P.R.D. Collectible Ring — Hellboy II: The Golden Army

A collectible ring featuring the emblem of the Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense, the supernatural agency from Guillermo del Toro’s Hellboy II: The Golden Army (2008). Produced as a wearable replica of the film accessory, the ring combines a base-metal alloy with blue and black enamel detailing.

Manufacturer: Gentle Giant Studios
Release: April 7, 2010 (size 10 retail listing)
Original retail price: $25 (size 10)
Catalog number: OCT091566
Material: Base-metal alloy with blue and black enamel
Replica scale: 1:1
Sizes: 10, 11, 12
Edition size: Not documented
